DZA.note: Document does not mention public procurement.
Regulations on payment service providers are named without a licensing statement; the switch is run by GIE Monetique and the instant payment scheme is not yet in service.
Only security and data-protection requirements are mentioned; no complaints body or conduct rule.
Document does not mention cross-border payments.
Document does not mention government payments to people.
Card and terminal counts only; no survey share of adults.

facts.fact: The GIE Monetique director says mobile payment based on QR codes appeared in 2025, with BaridiPay and the BNA app already offering interbank mobile payment.

The GIE Monetique director says bank mobile solutions integrated into the Switch mobile give interoperability between mobile payment solutions, and interbank mobile payment was officially launched a few months ago with seven pilot banks.
The GIE Monetique director says electronic payment in the public sector is almost fully generalised, covering payment of taxes, bills, insurance, fees and administrative documents.
